description: The GripForge docs, embedded in this MCP (readable offline, versioned with it), as Markdown. Without topic: the list of topics. With topic: its text, or one section (section = a heading, its number such as "4.2", or words of it); a long topic answers its table of contents first unless a section is given or full=true. Topics: web-export, godot, unity, unreal, desktop, rooms-server, central-server, c-api, lod, collision, glossary, kit-api, third-party, player, render-budget, scene-optim, porting, game-schema, module-calls, module-calls-native, godot-host, kit-modules, kit-structures, kit-third-party, abi, modding, game-engine-contract, game-engine. Read "third-party" and "porting" + "abi" before writing a presentation module, "modding" before writing a mod, "glossary" for the words. A kit's own API reference is gripforge_gamekit_api. 0 credits.

full.description: true: the whole topic even when long.

section.description: A heading of the topic, its number ("3.1", "§4") or words of it.
